entities.summary: Zaryn Dentzel is an American computer scientist and entrepreneur. He founded Tuenti in 2006. There was attempt to steal millions in Bitcoins in 2021. Dentzel was born in Santa Barbara, California in 1983. He moved to Spain in the 1990s.
